steps.text: Leave Castle Drakan.

Pick up the crank wheel from where you died!
Spam click the crank base outside the house to the north west. Drakan will start chasing you. Run away if he gets too close.
Enter the house north of the crank base.

Read the dusty book and retrieve the vitur key.

Enter the north-eastern vitur manor.
Pick up the bolt cutters from where you died!

Combine the loop and tooth half of key into the myrmel key.

Pick up the bucket from the house with the myrmel door, east of the well.
Use the bucket on the well outside the house.
Return to the myrmel house with the bucket of water.
Use the bucket of water on the northern barrel to retrieve the shadum key.
Pick up the trapdoor key from where you died!
Enter the shadum door south-west of the drawbridge and pick up the trapdoor key.
Pick up the trapdoor key from the shadum house south-west of the drawbridge.
Enter the bank north-west of the well.
Spam click the crank base in the bank.
Enter the trapdoor.
Pick up the jovkai key from where you died!
Search the chest in the western room of the altar house.
Search the chest in the western room of the altar house.
altar chest
Leave the altar room, then head to the smithy in the south-west.
Enter the smithy in the south-west.
Pick up the old cog from where you died!
Pick up the old cog from the table in the smithy in the south-west.
Return to Vanescula by the drawbridge to the south-east. Drakan will chase you when you leave the smithy.
Return to Vanescula by the drawbridge and talk to Ivan Strom for some supplies. You can drop the bucket.
choices: Could I have those supplies you found?

steps.text: Return to Vanescula by the drawbridge to the south-east when you're ready to leave. Drakan will chase you through the woods. Dodge his attacks, protect from melee.

Learn to fight Lowerniel Drakan. Protect from melee and dodge his attacks.

During this tutorial segment, there will be glimmering sparks that attempt to show you where to click to dodge his attacks.
Resupply at the shelter remains in the middle. When you've resupplied, click the trees around you to continue.
Resupply at the shelter remains in the middle. When you've resupplied, click the trees to continue.
Kill the ancient feral vyres. They swap positions and heal, so try to focus one at a time.
Enter Darkwood trees to continue.
Take the axe from the stump at the beginning.
Turn off run before continuing.
Make your way through the tangle of trees to the darkwood trees in the north-east, chopping down and climbing over trees on the way. Trees can only be chopped once per direction.

Turn off run. Avoid the Maxilla beasts. Running nearby, walking within 2 tiles, or standing on the maxilla beast will cause them to attack you and probably kill you. The first and third follow predetermined paths, while the second one moves randomly. Be extra careful when passing it.
Leave through the cave in the south-east. The first and third follow predetermined paths, while the second one moves randomly. Be extra careful when passing it.
Continue through the cave.

Kill the nylocas. Gray ones with melee, yellow ones with a ranged weapon. You can pick up the Spine near the Venator corpse to use as darts. If you do not kill them fast enough, they explode dealing 15 damage.
When all nylocas are dead, leave through the trees.
Wrangle the snakes, then combine them into one long snake. You must stand behind the snake when attempting to wrangle it.
Combine the snakes into one long snake.
Use the serpent rope on the long branched tree.
Swing across the water with your newly created swing.
Leave through the trees.
Talk to the Mysterious Woman.
Talk to Efaritay Hallow in the west room to help her with her son.
Pick some amitire leaves from the amitire plant outside the palace.
Pick some amitire leaves from the amitire plant outside the palace.
Enter the palace with the amitire leaves.
Search the shelves next to the sink for a bowl.
Fill the bowl with water.
Take a potato from the cupboard.
Put the potato in the bowl of water.
Take some raw meat the cupboard.
Cook the raw meat on the range.
Put the cooked meat in the incomplete stew.
Cook the stew on the range.
Put the amitire leaves into the stew.
Give the amitire stew to Safalaan Hallow.
Talk to Safalaan Hallow after feeding him the stew.
Talk to Efaritay Hallow after feeding Safalaan the stew.
Search the workbench in the east room for a hammer.
Search the workbench in the east room for a chisel.
Search the workbench in the east room for a knife.
Search the northern-most crate for some blisterwood logs.
Search the eastern-most crate for a blessed silver sickle.
Search the eastern-most chest for a diamond.
Put the unenchanted diamond on the blessed silver sickle.
Search the western-most chest for a diamond tablet.
Enchant the diamond sickle with the enchant diamond tablet.
Combine the blisterwood logs with your newly created enchanted diamond sickle to create an enhanced blisterwood sickle.
Smith a hallowed flail at the anvil.
Talk to Ivan Strom after smithing the hallowed flail.
Search the workbench for a knife.
Search the northern-most crate for some blisterwood logs to craft stakes.
Fletch the logs into stakes.
Return to  Ivan Strom after crafting some stakes. You can craft more before continuing if you want to use them during the upcoming fights.
Talk to Veliaf in the dungeon downstairs.
Talk to Veliaf in the dungeon.
Talk to Vanescula Drakan.
Talk to Veliaf in the dungeon again.
Climb upstairs.
Talk to Sugadinti Vitur after helping out Ivan and Veliaf.
Get ready for combat. Resupply at the supply table in the kitchen if needed. Speak to the Aranei next to the table if you want to deposit any items into your bank. Then leave the palace.

Protect the palace.
Attack the portals in the sky.
Leave the palace.
Heal fallen Aranei, repair damaged windows, and repair damaged pillars.
Pass through barricade to return to the guarding step.
Pass through the barricade, ready to fight Lowerniel Drakan. You can resupply at the supply table in the kitchen.

Fight Lowerniel Drakan. Protect from melee and dodge his attacks.

Dodge at least one tile opposite of the telegraphed motion.

When he holds his spear back, step to his side.
Watch the cutscene.
Talk to Ivan Strom in the haunted woods.
Enter the Burgh de Rott Myreque base.
Talk to Veliaf Hurtz in the Burgh de Rott Myreque base.
Talk to Sugadinti Vitur in Burgh de Rott.
Gear up for theatre of blood. Bring melee gear with a range and mage switch, some food & potions, then talk to Sugadinti Vitur in front of the theatre of blood.
Kill Nylocas with the correct fighting style. Fight the Maiden of Sugadinti, killing healers when they spawn. Avoid blood puddles on the ground.
Talk to Sugadinti Vitur.
Head to the abandoned building north-east of Burgh de Rott and talk to Veliaf.
Head to the abandoned building north-east of Burgh de Rott and enter the entry.

Fight the Wyrd. Protect from melee against the normal attacks, and turn it off when it screeches similar to a Venator.

First phase:
He will punch twice, then unleash a screech attack. After screeching twice, he will smash the ground matching which hand he hit you with the two most recent punches.

Second phase:
Instead of the screech attach, he will use a lightning attack that spawns blood pools around you. These pools disappear over time. Turn off your protection prayer and leave his area, avoiding any pools.
Search for the escaped wyrd. Inspect the fence north of barrows.
Talk to Veliaf Hurtz in the Burgh de Rott hideout.

Talk to Sugadinti Vitur in the Burgh de Rott hideout, ready for another fight against Drakan.

Enter the portal in Icyene Graveyard to get to Vampyrium, ready for the final confrontation.
Enter the door, ready to fight Drakan. You can get supplies and deposit items at the chest next to the door.

Dodge at least one tile opposite of the telegraphed motion.

When he holds his spear back, step to his side.

Dodge over the blood waves.

Protect from magic when he shoots his blood spears.

Avoid shadows and blood pools on the ground.

Step behind him when he raises his spear above his shoulder.

When he rushes around you, dodge in the direction of his first cloud.
Talk to Efaritay Hallow in the icyene graveyard.
Congratulations on finishing the quest!
Talk to Sarius Guile in the Icyene Graveyard to start the quest.
Look for Ivan in the Myreque Hideout below Old Man Ral's home in Meiyerditch.
Inspect the makeshift shrine in the Myreque Hideout below Old Man Ral's home in Meiyerditch.
Talk to Ivan in the Myreque Hideout below Old Man Ral's home in Meiyerditch while wearing the vyre noble outfit, ready for a fight.
choices: Are you ready to go to Darkmeyer?

steps.text: Talk to Ivan in the Myreque Hideout below Old Man Ral's home in Meiyerditch to return to the Castle Drakan courtyard.
choices: We'd better get back to Darkmeyer.

steps.text: Kill the vyrewatches and defend Ivan Strom until he can teleport you both out. Kill the approaching acidic bloodvelds with a ranged weapon. Prioritize the Vyrewatch Sentinels.
Talk to Ivan in the Myreque Hideout below Old Man Ral's home in Meiyerditch after escaping.
Talk to Ivan Strom in the graveyard outside the Slepe church.
Talk to Roy the bartender in Slepe and ask him about Veliaf's whereabouts.
choices: We're looking for a friend of ours.

Kill vampyres. Focus on the Vyrewatch Sentinels. Avoid the Blood orb. Lure Vyrewatches into the Blood orbs to deal massive damage to them.
